fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/ListingPages/BestTrucks.cy.js#ListingPages - NewListingPages [bestTrucks] [en] — Best Trucks TC-NLP-02: Check Truck Price lead submits successfully on Best Trucks
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-NLP-02
**Title:** Check Truck Price lead submits successfully on Best Trucks
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Best Trucks listing page, click Check Truck Price to open its lead form, fill name, mobile and city, and submit.

**Expected Result:**
A Thank You confirmation is shown after a successful lead submission. The submitted name is tagged with a page/CTA identifier for CRM traceability.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Best Trucks listing page
2. Click Check Truck Price to open its lead form
3. Fill name, mobile and city
4. Submit and verify the confirmation
